title: Shishou, the Akashic sword
text: Shishou is a relic sword that talks, flies and levels up. It has 38 skills (31 original and 7 added in 4.45), a top grade called EX-Singularity, a hunter mode and a fast flurry (server setting flurryFast). The Reset Scroll resets it, with a guard against misuse. Thrown, it follows you and fights hostile mobs as a pet (setting pet.mode); give orders with /multiverse shishou order follow|stay|attack.
